title: Find the short names of teams that have a build-up play speed of at least 7
question: Find the short names of teams that have a build-up play speed of at least 70 and whose country hosted a league with more than 200 matches in the 2008/2009 season.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.XCL_174
FROM Team AS T1
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.XCL_171 = T2.XCL_177
WHERE T2.XCL_180 = 'Fast'
  AND T1.XCL_172 IN (
    SELECT L.XCL_004
    FROM League AS L
    INNER JOIN Match AS M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
    WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
    GROUP BY L.XCL_004
    HAVING COUNT(M.XCL_006) > 200
  )
